headline: Over $600 million traded on Polymarket election markets after races ended
summary: More than $600 million in Polymarket election-contract trades took place after the outcomes of elections in Ethiopia and Romania had already been decided, with one expert calling it a form of volume manipulation.

claims.statement: Over $600 million in Polymarket election trades took place after the race outcomes had already been decided.

sources.quote: Over $600 Million in Polymarket Election Trades Took Place After Races Ended
Polymarket saw $600 million in election trades after the elections were over

claims.statement: The trades involved contracts tied to elections in Ethiopia and Romania.

sources.quote: Contracts tied to elections in Ethiopia and Romania saw massive trading volumes after the outcomes were decided.

claims.statement: An expert described the post-outcome trading as a form of volume manipulation.

sources.quote: “It’s obviously some form of volume manipulation,” one expert says.
